answer.explanation: src/domain/ticket.ts imports UuidGenerator from the outbound adapter layer (line 1) and instantiates it in the constructor (line 8). The domain core therefore depends on an adapter, which FF-S04 flags because core code should depend on ports, not adapters. ADR-0005 is Accepted and current. It says on purpose that the domain core may import UuidGenerator directly from src/adapters/outbound/uuid-generator.ts and that no IdGenerator port is introduced for now. That line grants this exact case, so the finding is consistent with declared intent and falls under a declared exception.

citation.quote: The domain core is permitted to import UuidGenerator from src/adapters/outbound/uuid-generator.ts directly.

exceptionClaim.scope: Domain core (src/domain/ticket.ts) importing UuidGenerator directly from src/adapters/outbound/uuid-generator.ts, with no IdGenerator port.
